title: First Vnus Box Unimpressed...
text:
Received my first Vnus Box yesterday. I am very unimpressed with Box. I thought it would have some good black own products, nope. 2 out of 7 for me (pictures posted). The Flawless Repairing Deep Conditioning Masque and Fenty Beauty lipstick (although not sure about the color) Spanked. I will not cancel though maybe it was just a fluke other subscription Box I receive have off months as well.
I haven't not tried the Conditioning Masque yet, but in reading the package it had promis. Dosa Aromatherapy Collection Chamomile & Lavender Exotic Mineral Bath Salts (pictured) would make 3 of 7 but I have very sensitive skin. Planter by Motherland cool item, just not sure what going to grow 🤔 lol. Lip Blam (although it says Motherland) and Hand Sanitizer I did not receive Hand Sanitize. Body Bands are nice they have resistance levels markings on each band.
label: negative
